Tuesday Night Ride (NoVA Casual Bicycling Group)

Arlington, VA · Shirlington · Road · Social

Tuesday Night Ride (NoVA Casual Bicycling Group) is a road and social group ride in Arlington, VA. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:30 pm from Shirlington Library. About 15 miles, no-drop, up to 15 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Night Ride (NoVA Casual Bicycling Group) group ride

A B-group out-and-back on the trails from Shirlington toward Belle Haven. Nobody gets left behind but you are expected to hold around 15 mph. Helmets required, riders 18 and up. The same group runs a Wednesday beginner ride to the Dairy Godmother and a Thursday ride from Jones Point.
